name: ARN Smart Duplicate Post & Content Toolkit
author: arnsmart

sections.description:
ARN Smart Duplicate Post & Content Toolkit duplicates posts and pages the safe way: every copy is created as a draft you review before anything goes live. Prepare a copy with a new title, create content variations, or find similar drafts before you write a new one.

Smart Find & Replace previews every change before it is applied, and the toolkit understands Elementor and other page builders, so layouts and builder data are copied and updated correctly instead of breaking.

✨ Why Content Toolkit?

  • Drafts first – copies are drafts by default and go live only if you choose a published status and your account may publish that content type.
  • One click from the list – the Copy link in the Posts, Pages and Products lists makes a full draft copy and opens it in the editor.
  • Layouts and fields stay intact – Elementor and block editor content, the data of other page builders, custom and ACF fields, SEO fields and terms are copied with the post.
  • Nothing on the front end – it runs only in the WordPress admin; visitors’ pages load none of its code.
  • No account, no license key, nothing sent to ARN – only the outside connections you start, listed under External services.
  • WordPress permissions respected – every action checks your right to edit the source and create or publish the copy; the history shows only content you can edit.

📄 Duplicate posts, pages and products

Copy a post, page, WooCommerce product or custom post type item without rebuilding it.

  • Copy link: hover a row in any supported list, custom post types included, and click Copy; a full draft copy titled “{title} (Copy)” opens in the editor.
  • Complete copies: content, excerpt, featured image, categories, tags and custom taxonomy terms, custom fields, page template, parent page, menu order, comment settings and the post password are copied; you become the author of the copy.
  • Independent records: every copy is a new item, and the source is never changed.
  • Permalinks without conflicts: a draft copy takes its permalink from the title you save; other copies get a unique slug that keeps non-Latin letters.
  • Only real content: media files, revisions, menus, reusable blocks, theme templates and ACF field groups are not offered, so copies never share files or settings with originals.

✏️ Prepare copies with new titles and variations

The ARN Clonex screen prepares copies from one workflow form.

  • Prepare with New Title: a draft copy with the title you type and a matching permalink; leave the field empty for “{title} (Copy)”.
  • Content Preparation: up to 10 draft copies of one item in a single run – for landing page, service page or location variations.
  • Workflow modes: Draft Prep copies everything; Structure Only leaves out the featured image and SEO fields; Media-Free Prep leaves out the featured image.
  • One-click presets: Draft Prep, Structure Only, Media-Free Prep, Prep + Rename, Quick Replace and Move Category fill in the form for you.
  • Status choice: Draft (the default), Pending or Publish.
  • Child pages: a child page’s copy goes under its parent’s copy when the parent was copied first.

🔄 Find & Replace and category moves

Change wording or reorganize terms after a preview, without editing items one by one.

  • Replace Text: replace a word, phrase, location or product name in the title and content of one item, or leave “Replace With” empty to remove it. Matching is exact, including percent values such as “%50” and special characters.
  • Builder-safe replace: on Elementor, Beaver Builder, Bricks or Oxygen pages, only the title changes and you are told to edit the page text in the builder, so layouts never break.
  • Move Category / Taxonomy: move every item from one term to another in post categories and tags, WooCommerce product taxonomies and custom taxonomies. Drafts, pending, private and scheduled items move too.
  • Large terms in steps: large terms move in short steps; the notice shows how many items remain, and running the move again continues.
  • Permission aware: the move checks that you may assign terms of that taxonomy and edit each item.

🌐 Similar Draft from a public URL

Turn a public page into an editable draft that you review first – no automatic publishing, no autonomous crawling, no background mass scraping.

  • Analyze and preview: see a public URL’s cleaned content, word count and detected images before anything is saved.
  • Clean content: scripts, styles, menus, headers, footers, forms, embedded frames, share buttons and the repeated page title are removed; relative links and images get full addresses, and pages in other character sets are converted.
  • Edit before saving: edit the title and content in the WordPress editor and choose the content type (post, page or another public type); the result is always a draft.
  • Images under your control: pick up to 30 images per page, add them to the Media Library with local addresses, use the first one as featured image and remove it from the body. Only real image files are added, images over the upload limit are skipped, and images already imported from the same address are reused.
  • Without upload permission: users who cannot upload files get a draft that keeps the original image addresses.
  • Fair-use limits: 3 saved drafts per day on the site and 10 URL analyses per user per hour; fetching a preview does not use the daily quota.
  • Nothing lost: if the page cannot be read again at save time, your edited title and content are still saved as a draft, without images.

👁️ Preview, history and permissions

See what an action will do before it runs, and what it did afterwards.

  • Mini Preview: shows the affected item count, sample titles and warnings, such as a missing term or empty search text, before an action runs.
  • Content detection: the content picker lists your 60 most recently changed items and names their builder (Elementor, Gutenberg, WPBakery, Beaver Builder, Bricks, Divi or Oxygen); WooCommerce products are marked.
  • Result summary: successful and failed items after each run, with a link to the prepared draft.
  • Action history: the latest actions with before and after values (title, replaced text, source and target term), only for content you can edit.
  • Light integrity check: each copy is checked for an empty title, unfilled {placeholders} and a missing featured image, and the result is stored with the copy.
  • WordPress permissions: the ARN Clonex screen is for users who can edit posts; copying needs permission to create the content type, and Publish to publish it.

🧩 Page builders, fields and WooCommerce

Copies keep the page’s structure and data, so they behave like the source.

  • Elementor: page data and settings are copied as stored, and Elementor rebuilds the copy’s styles. In ARN Clonex copies, references to the source page inside the builder data point to the copy. Saved templates (container, header, footer) keep their template type.
  • Block editor (Gutenberg): blocks are copied as blocks.
  • Other page builders: the data of Beaver Builder, Divi, WPBakery, Avada, Oxygen, Bricks, GenerateBlocks, Kadence Blocks and Stackable is copied with the post as stored.
  • SEO fields: the fields of Yoast SEO, Rank Math and All in One SEO are copied (left out in Structure Only).
  • Custom and ACF fields: field values and their ACF field references are copied.
  • WooCommerce products: product data, images, gallery, categories and tags are copied; the copy gets a unique SKU, an empty GTIN and no sales or reviews, and appears in price sorting and filters. Variations of a variable product are not copied.
  • ARN Free AI screen: the bundled Settings → ARN Free AI is the shared AI connection screen of ARN Free plugins (provider, your own API key stored encrypted, model, usage and monthly limits). The toolkit itself sends no AI requests.
  • ARN Smart Clonex Pro: with an active Pro licence on the same site, the toolkit pauses and Pro provides the same tools under its own ARN Clonex menu; settings and copies are kept.

🔒 Privacy, performance and your data

  • Front-end, REST and cron requests load none of its code; its script and styles load only on its own screens and content lists.
  • No account, no license key and no ARN server; updates come from WordPress.org.
  • Outside connections start only from you: Similar Draft fetches the page you enter; ARN Free AI contacts only the provider an administrator sets up, when they test it. Both are listed under External services.
  • “Delete all Content Toolkit data when the plugin is deleted” (off by default, administrators only, bottom of the ARN Clonex screen) removes the toolkit’s settings, history, logs, temporary data and tracking fields. Posts, pages and images created with the plugin are never deleted.
  • Multisite-aware: each site of a network keeps its own history and data choice.

⭐ Go further with ARN Smart Clonex Pro

ARN Smart Clonex Pro includes everything in the free toolkit and adds:

  • A five-step Duplicate screen (Input, Configure, Preview, Process, Result) with copy parts you switch per run and slug modes: Auto, Keep Source Slug, Pattern and SEO Friendly.
  • Bulk Duplicate and Bulk Duplicate as Draft in the list bulk actions, and Bulk Management for taxonomy edits, category moves and content replace with plain, placeholder or regex matching, smart filters and saved operations.
  • Smart Replace inside Elementor widgets: it changes widget text (titles, text, buttons, list items) and leaves colours, fonts, IDs and link addresses untouched.
  • Templates, variation profiles and CSV or JSON datasets with placeholders such as {city}, and Production that creates many drafts row by row or as every combination, with a preview first.
  • URL Import without a daily limit, and Bulk URL Import from a list or CSV file that can build each draft from a saved template.
  • Batch jobs with Pause, Resume, Cancel and Retry of failed items, and a Debug Console with logs, failed items and an exportable report.
  • Licence management in ARN Center and private Pro updates.

The free toolkit works fully on its own and never requires Pro.

🔗 More from ARN Smart

Free on WordPress.org, usable alone or together:

  • ARN Smart AI-Powered Site Utilities for Elementor – Elementor widgets, header & footer builder, SEO and schema.
  • ARN Smart AI-Powered Visitor Intent – visitor-intent capture, triggers, analytics and contact actions.
  • ARN Smart Image Optimizer – local WebP and AVIF image optimization.
  • ARN Smart URL Manager – short links, redirects, QR codes and local analytics.

Pro editions with more power and priority support: Vendix, Visioix, WebPix, Clonex, Linkix, SiteWatch, Contix and DualFix. Explore all products at ARN Smart.

External services

The Toolkit connects to external websites only in the Similar Draft workflow, and only when a user asks for it. The bundled Settings > ARN Free AI screen contacts an AI provider only when an administrator uses it (see “ARN Free AI” below).

Similar Draft.

  • What is contacted: the public web page whose URL the user enters, and the image addresses found on that page that the user selects (these can be on other hosts, such as an image CDN).
  • When: when the user clicks to analyze the URL and again when the user saves the draft; selected images are downloaded when the draft is saved.
  • What is sent: a standard HTTP request for that address. The request includes a User-Agent header with the plugin name and this site’s address. No content, user data, or analytics are sent to ARN Smart or to any other service.
  • What is received: the page HTML (up to 2 MB) used to build the editable draft, and the selected images (at most 30, only images listed on that page, only real image files), which are added to the Media Library. Images are downloaded only for users who can upload files; for other users the draft keeps the original image addresses.
  • Limits: each user can analyze at most 10 URLs per hour.

The contacted website is chosen by the user, and that website’s own terms of use and privacy policy apply. Only copy content you have the right to use.

ARN Free AI (Settings > ARN Free AI). The plugin bundles ARN Free AI, the shared AI settings screen of ARN Free plugins. ARN Smart Duplicate Post & Content Toolkit itself sends no content to any AI provider and does not contact any ARN server. Only when a site administrator chooses a provider on that screen and clicks “Test connection” (one short fixed test prompt, no site content) or “Load models” (the provider’s model list) is a request sent, with the administrator’s own API key, to that provider only, at that moment. The API key is stored encrypted in the WordPress database. No data is sent to any other provider.

  • OpenAI: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use , https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
  • Anthropic (Claude): https://www.anthropic.com/legal/commercial-terms , https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy
  • Google Gemini: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms , https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • DeepSeek: https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-terms-of-use.html , https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-privacy-policy.html
  • Moonshot AI (Kimi): https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/agreement/modeluse , https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/agreement/userprivacy
  • xAI (Grok): https://x.ai/legal/terms-of-service , https://x.ai/legal/privacy-policy
  • Mistral AI: https://legal.mistral.ai/terms , https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/privacy-policy
  • OpenAI-compatible endpoint: requests go to the address the administrator enters; that service’s own terms apply.

If WordPress AI is chosen instead, the test request goes through the provider connected in WordPress (Settings > Connectors) under that provider’s terms.
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, go to Plugins → Add New, search for ARN Smart Duplicate Post & Content Toolkit, then install and activate it. You can also upload the ZIP under Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Open Posts, Pages or Products, hover a row and click Copy: a full draft copy opens in the editor.
  3. For new titles, several copies, Replace Text or Move Category / Taxonomy, open ARN Clonex in the admin menu, choose an action or a preset, check the Mini Preview and click Run Workflow Action.
  4. To prepare a draft from a public page, open ARN Clonex → Similar Draft, enter the URL and click Fetch Preview.
  5. Optional, for administrators: at the bottom of the ARN Clonex screen, decide whether the toolkit’s data is deleted with the plugin.
sections.faq:
Do I need ARN Smart Clonex Pro or a license key?

No. ARN Smart Duplicate Post & Content Toolkit is free, works on its own and needs no account or license key; updates come from WordPress.org. ARN Smart Clonex Pro is optional and adds bulk jobs, templates, datasets and URL imports without a daily limit. When Pro runs on the same site with an active licence, the toolkit pauses and Pro provides the same tools; your settings and copies are kept, and the toolkit works again when Pro is deactivated.

Will it slow down my site?

No. The plugin runs only in the WordPress admin, so visitors’ pages, REST and cron requests load none of its code. In the admin, its script and styles load only on its own screens and on content lists.

Does it work on WordPress Multisite?

Yes. Each site of a network has its own ARN Clonex screen, action history and “Delete all Content Toolkit data” choice, and copies are made within the same site.

What happens to my data when I delete the plugin?

By default, only a few old setting names are removed and your Toolkit data is kept. If an administrator enables “Delete all Content Toolkit data when the plugin is deleted” on the ARN Clonex screen, deleting the plugin also removes the Toolkit’s settings, action history, process log, temporary Similar Draft data, and the tracking fields the Toolkit added to posts and images. On Multisite this is applied on each site according to that site’s own setting. With the setting on, the shared ARN Free AI settings, saved API keys and usage history of the sites where it is on are removed too, but only when no other installed ARN Free plugin (active or not) still uses them. Posts, pages, and images created with the plugin are never deleted, and data of the Pro version (ARN Smart Clonex) is not touched.

Does it send data to external services or AI?

Only when you start it, and never to an ARN server. Similar Draft fetches the public page you enter and the images you select; the bundled Settings → ARN Free AI screen contacts the AI provider an administrator chooses only when they click “Test connection” or “Load models”. The toolkit itself sends no content to any AI provider. Every connection is listed under External services.

Does it publish copies or change my content automatically?

No. Copies are drafts by default and Similar Draft always creates a draft; the ARN Clonex screen also offers Pending and Publish, used only when you choose them and your account may publish that content type. Nothing runs in the background: Replace Text and Move Category / Taxonomy change existing content only when you run them, after the Mini Preview.

Does it keep Elementor and other page builder layouts?

Yes. Elementor data and page settings are copied as stored and Elementor rebuilds the copy’s styles; block editor content and the data of other builders such as Beaver Builder, Divi, WPBakery, Bricks and Oxygen are copied with the post. On builder pages, Replace Text changes only the title, so the layout is not broken.

Can I duplicate WooCommerce products?

Yes. The Copy link works in the Products list, and the copy keeps the product data, images, gallery, categories and tags, gets a unique SKU and starts with no sales or reviews. Variations of a variable product are not copied.

Can I create a draft from another website?

Yes, one page at a time and always after your review. Similar Draft (ARN Clonex → Similar Draft) analyzes a public URL, shows the cleaned content and images, and saves a draft only when you click Save Similar Draft, up to 3 drafts per day on the site. There is no automatic publishing, crawling or background scraping; only copy content you have the right to use.

Which content can I duplicate?

Posts, pages, WooCommerce products and every public custom post type with an admin screen, including Elementor saved templates. Media files, revisions, menus, reusable blocks, theme templates and ACF field groups are not offered, so a copy never shares a file or setting with its original.
sections.changelog:
1.1.4

  • Changed: the plugin is now called ARN Smart Duplicate Post & Content Toolkit. Its folder, slug and settings are unchanged; nothing needs to be done after updating.
  • Fixed: a copy of a password-protected post or page keeps its password. Before, a copy made with the Publish status could show the protected text to visitors.
  • Fixed: copies of Elementor saved templates (container, header, footer) keep their template type.
  • Fixed: Move Category / Taxonomy works with every taxonomy the screen lists, checks that you may assign its terms, and moves large categories in short steps instead of timing out.
  • Fixed: Replace Text on pages built with Elementor, Beaver Builder, Bricks or Oxygen changes only the title and tells you to change the page text in the builder, so builder layouts are not broken. Pages of a builder that is no longer active are handled as normal pages.
  • Fixed: find and replace keeps percent values such as “%50” and special characters as typed.
  • Fixed: Similar Draft: the title comes from the article heading, relative links and images get full addresses, the heading is not repeated in the body, image addresses written with “&” are replaced by the local copies, images larger than the upload limit are skipped, pages in other character sets are converted, and the draft is still saved (without images) when the page cannot be read a second time.
  • Fixed: slugs keep non-Latin letters, and scheduled copies use the site’s time zone.
  • Fixed: WooCommerce product copies get a unique SKU and start with empty sales counters.
  • Fixed: only posts, pages and other content types can be duplicated; media items, revisions and blocks are refused.
  • Fixed: Simple Mode shows an error when nothing could be changed, and its screen loads the terms once, so it stays fast on sites with many categories. Its texts can be translated.
  • Fixed: when ARN Smart Clonex (Pro) is active, the toolkit’s own actions return to the Plugins screen instead of running.
  • Fixed: with “Delete all Content Toolkit data when the plugin is deleted” on, the temporary Similar Draft lock is removed too.
  • Fixed: Shared ARN Free AI 1.0.6: the retry message shows the real number of attempts; the screen updates after “Remove saved key” and “Clear usage history”; a key set in wp-config.php is not sent to a changed endpoint; reasoning models get no temperature setting; deleting a network site removes its usage table.

Earlier versions: changelog.txt

The contacted website is chosen by the user, and that website’s own terms of use and privacy policy apply. Only copy content you have the right to use.

ARN Free AI (Settings > ARN Free AI). The plugin bundles ARN Free AI, the shared AI settings screen of ARN Free plugins. ARN Smart Duplicate Post & Content Toolkit itself sends no content to any AI provider and does not contact any ARN server. Only when a site administrator chooses a provider on that screen and clicks “Test connection” (one short fixed test prompt, no site content) or “Load models” (the provider’s model list) is a request sent, with the administrator’s own API key, to that provider only, at that moment. The API key is stored encrypted in the WordPress database. No data is sent to any other provider.

  • OpenAI: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use , https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
  • Anthropic (Claude): https://www.anthropic.com/legal/commercial-terms , https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy
  • Google Gemini: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms , https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • DeepSeek: https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-terms-of-use.html , https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-privacy-policy.html
  • Moonshot AI (Kimi): https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/agreement/modeluse , https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/agreement/userprivacy
  • xAI (Grok): https://x.ai/legal/terms-of-service , https://x.ai/legal/privacy-policy
  • Mistral AI: https://legal.mistral.ai/terms , https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/privacy-policy
  • OpenAI-compatible endpoint: requests go to the address the administrator enters; that service’s own terms apply.

If WordPress AI is chosen instead, the test request goes through the provider connected in WordPress (Settings > Connectors) under that provider’s terms.
